text.p: Premier league runners-up Arsenal will be without midfielder David Platt for the visit of championship rivals Aston Villa on Saturday.

The former Villa man picked up a hamstring injury in Arsenal's goalless draw at Sheffield Wednesday on Thursday. But Patrick Vieira has completed his suspension and is available to partner fellow Frenchman Reme Garde in midfield.

Central defender Martin Keown is expected to play despite a gashed shin, but Scotland under-21 international Scott Marshall and Andy Linighan stand by as right-back Lee Dixon also faces a late fitness test.
